answer_1.quote: In this work, we tackle the problem of generating high-quality CS text using only limited amounts of real CS text during training.

answer_2.quote: We present a rigorous evaluation of the quality of our generated text using multiple objective metrics and a human evaluation study

answer_4.quote: We evaluated the quality of sentences generated by TCS using a human evaluation study.
answer_4.guideline: three linguistic experts in Hindi and they were asked to provide scores ranging between 1 and 5 (1 for worst, 5 for best) under three heads: 'Syntactic correctness', 'Semantic correctness' and 'Naturalness'
